json.reason: Classic mutable default argument: a function parameter defaulting to a list/dict/set literal, which is created once and shared across all calls. Purely syntactic and recurs anywhere.
json.title: Mutable default argument shared between calls
json.message: Mutable default argument: this default list/dict/set is created once and shared by every call
json.note: Python evaluates default values once at function definition time, so a `[]`, `{}` or `set()` default is reused (and mutated) across all calls, leaking state between callers. Use `None` as the default and build the container inside the body: `def f(x, tags=None): if tags is None: tags = []`.
json.rule_yaml:
rule:
  any:
    - kind: default_parameter
    - kind: typed_default_parameter
  has:
    field: value
    any:
      - kind: list
      - kind: dictionary
      - kind: set
      - pattern: list()
      - pattern: dict()
      - pattern: set()
